# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old.  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-looking man with an awkward frame and stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since he was twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is timid, bashful, and deeply awkward, particularly around women, whom he generally fears and suspects of quietly mocking him. Despite his extreme shyness, he possesses a deeply kind and generous heart, showing great gentleness and patience toward others. He tends to defer to his sister Thirza's firm authority on domestic matters.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)_

## Traits

- Timid and bashful around women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014)</sub>
- Kind-hearted and gentle  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c6 P33](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0033), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)</sub>
- Easily flustered  <sub>[v1 c25 P15](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0015), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- To provide a good, loving home for Nell  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025)</sub>

## History

Obed traveled to the Alder River station expecting to collect a boy from an orphan asylum brought by Mrs. Alexander Tranter. Upon arriving, he was astonished to discover that a girl, young Nell Harcourt, had been left for him instead. Unable to bring himself to turn her away, he brought her to Grey Shutters to let his sister Thirza manage the situation. After learning that the alternative for Nell was being taken in by Mrs. Scobie, Obed advocated for keeping her, declaring he would not give a dog he cared for to Mrs. Scobie. Sometime later, wanting to buy Nell a gift, he nervously entered an unfamiliar store to buy dress fabric, became thoroughly flustered, and ended up purchasing an unwanted garden rake and twenty pounds of brown sugar. He subsequently sought the advice of Mrs. Sowerby, who agreed to purchase suitable material and make a modern dress for Nell on his behalf.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021), [v1 c25 P22](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0022), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Has worn a thick brown beard continuously since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Lived at Grey Shutters alongside his sister Thirza  <sub>[v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c2 P67](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0067)</sub>

## Quotes

> A girl is not what I’m expecting. A boy is who I’ve come for. Here is where he should be. For me, Mrs. Alexander Tranter was supposed to bring him over from Nova Scotia.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> I regret that I arrived late. Follow me. Over in the yard is where the horse is waiting. Let me take your bag.  <sub>[v1 c2 P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018)</sub>

> That Scobie woman wouldn't be given a dog I had any affection for.  <sub>[v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030)</sub>

> Just treat her with as much goodness and kindness as you are able to while avoiding spoiling her. I have a feeling she belongs to the type that allows you to accomplish anything with them, provided you first win their affection.  <sub>[v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)</sub>

### Thirza Abernethy

- Sibling of — Obed's sister who manages the Grey Shutters household.  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>
